name: Vital
tagline: A licensed clinician on your phone, usually within fifteen minutes.
description: A multi-page telehealth site: conditions index with search and filters, condition pages with in-person red flags, a six-step symptom check-in that builds a live visit slip and triages to video, message or emergency care, pricing with a billing toggle, clinician profiles with bookable times, and an app page with authored phone screens.
